offering_description.value: The company sells fuel ethanol to fuel marketers and blenders, distillers grains to livestock feed buyers, and corn oil to industrial buyers. It processes corn at its plant in Lamberton, Minnesota.

primary_products.value: Fuel ethanol; distillers grains; distillers corn oil

customer_segment.value: B2B: Fuel marketers and blenders, livestock producers and feed suppliers, and corn oil processors

end_markets.value: Transportation fuels; livestock feed; biofuel feedstocks

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bulk sales of fuel ethanol, distillers grains, and corn oil

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes purchased corn into ethanol, feed ingredients, and corn oil for commercial buyers; asset operator: Operates a corn ethanol plant supplying fuel, feed, and corn oil buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Plant in Lamberton, southwestern Minnesota

specialization.value: related lines: Fuel ethanol, distillers grains, and corn oil from the same corn processing operation

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Third-party marketers for bulk ethanol sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard and Minnesota environmental permitting for ethanol production

notes: The full sales territory and the current distribution channels for distillers grains and corn oil are uncertain.
